3In the Workshop, track the materials for Gunsmith 2 and Gear Bench 2.

6Finish Sheltered Retreat: materials, then damage to flying ARC and the Bully.
7Scrappy 3 for 3 Lemon and 3 Apricot.
8Medical Lab 2, Utility Station 2, Explosives Station 2.
9Complete the Trials for 3 stars every week.

The Stamina Runner (Conditioning 19 · Mobility 41 · Survival 16) plan starts from an empty tree: after a reset in the game, click “Spend free points by the plan” and spend the same points in the game. The tree rules are simplified: a choice after 10 points in a branch, the middle tier only after the choice, the first capstone after 30 and the second after 40 points in the branch.

Changes in 2.0 that affect loadouts
Grenades deal more than 50% more damage to ARC armour plates and about 30% less to fragile parts.
Jupiter is stronger against armour, slightly weaker on weak points.
Heavy Shield wears down less (0.15 instead of 0.20) and slows you by only 10%.
Snap Hook has an 18 m range and costs 4% durability per use. Grappling Hook can also rappel and swing.
Anvil is now blue (rare); Bantam took over the role of the cheap hand cannon.

About

ARC Raiders Companion 0.3 · English as the second language.

An unofficial fan tool; not affiliated with or endorsed by Embark Studios. It works offline: the data stays on this computer, the app does not read the game's memory or files, does not start processes and does not communicate over the network.

Game data: the original diary (game state 2.0 Frozen Trail, November 2026), additions from public sources marked “Research · unverified” and your own edits.
